ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7) and advise the driver that "I'm Here" only supports a no-show fee after more than 3 minutes of waiting.
ruling.reasoning:
The driver cancelled this RydeX trip at 21:31:30, 5 min 30 s after acceptance, and a $6.61 cancellation fee was charged [F4][F7]. Under NS-0 the case therefore routes to the driver-cancelled branch, and because the driver's cancellation rests on a rider no-show it is NS-1/NS-2 that govern, not NS-4 [F4][F12][NS-0].

NS-1(i) is satisfied: the record shows a driver tap of "I'm Here" at 21:29:45 (a driver_tap, not a platform auto-confirmation) [F6][NS-1]. NS-1(ii) is also satisfied: at that moment the GPS placed the car 41 m from the pickup, inside the 200 m arrival radius [F6][F1][NS-1].

NS-1(iii) fails. The trace measures only 105 s continuously inside the radius after the tap, against the default threshold of more than 180 s (3 min 01 s) [F6][NS-1]. The chat is complete (2 messages, all timestamped) and adds nothing to bridge the gap: the driver's "I'm here" at 21:29 and "Cancelling, waited too long" at 21:31 do not evidence a wait exceeding three minutes, and the driver's post-trip statement of "at least 5 minutes" is a claim in the driver's own statement, which does not override the timeline and GPS records of the wait [F9][F10][F11][F12][F6][NS-1]. The earlier cumulative time within 200 m (2 min 55 s from 21:28:35) is time before the tap and is expressly not counted under NS-1 — and even that falls short of 3 min 01 s [F2][NS-1]. The driver was indeed stationary 21:29:25–21:31:30 at 39 m from pickup, but that is only 2 min 5 s of stationary time and the trace's post-tap-in-radius measure governs [F3][F6][NS-1].

Because NS-1(iii) does not hold, NS-2 applies: the rider's cancellation fee of $6.61 is refunded in full. The amount is the fee on record, $6.61 [F7][NS-2]. No rider-side conduct is in issue, and the trace's NS-2 flag condition (arrival confirmed while outside the radius) is not met — the tap occurred 41 m from the pickup, so no account flag is warranted for a fake confirmation [F6][NS-2]. The driver's profile (0 upheld disputes, 1 prior dispute in 90 d) cannot independently establish anything and does not trigger RD-6 in any event [F17][RD-6].

Safety screen: I read chat #1 ("I'm here, white BYD e6"), chat #2 ("Cancelling, waited too long"), the rider's complaint and the driver's statement; none contains any threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation [F9][F10][F12][SAFE-1].

Evidence is sufficient: the timeline, GPS trace and fare record settle the cancellation actor, the arrival confirmation, the radius, the wait duration and the fee amount, and the chat record is complete and timestamped with no GPS hole in the wait [F2][F4][F6][F7][F11][NS-1].
